forecasts.question: Will Iran and Oman formally publish an operational Strait of Hormuz transit framework — including named service fees or a defined per-vessel cost structure — before EOD 2026-08-22?
forecasts.delta_reason: Mohsen Rezaei appointed SNSC secretary Aug 9 (UPI; Daily Post Nigeria; India TV News), on Day 2 of the Muscat WG session (Aug 9-11). Rezaei commanded the IRGC 1981-1997 and publicly characterized Hormuz control as 'more important than dozens of atomic bombs.' The SNSC secretary is the institutional ratification layer for any Hormuz framework requiring IRGC sign-off — a blocker identified in prior runs. Positional gaps entering the session remain wide: Iran at 5-7% cargo-value fee vs. Oman's 3% cap; Iran demanding control of both shipping lanes vs. Oman's 50-50 split. Iran rejected Oman's Malacca-style voluntary-fee proposal July 28 before the current session began. Bloomberg Aug 6 'agreed in principle' report predates the Rezaei appointment and has not been corroborated by either government's official channels. No TIER1 source has published a named-fee document as of Aug 10 morning. DA opposing narrative partially accepted: WG session still running (1 full day remains, Aug 11), Oman's mediation record, and the 'legitimizing move' reading of the Rezaei appointment provide floor. Judge: p → 0.20 (above DA's proposed floor of 0.18; above Analyst's 0.20 — same).
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if the Iran-Oman joint working group, or either government on behalf of the bilateral arrangement, publicly releases a document naming specific service fees, per-vessel transit charges, or a defined cost schedule for commercial passage through the Strait of Hormuz — with both governments' endorsement confirmed — before EOD 2026-08-22.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/Bloomberg/Al Jazeera) OR official state media (Oman ONA + Iran IRNA/Tasnim) carrying the published fee schedule. Both governments must confirm or co-publish the document.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Reference to fees 'to be determined' or 'in accordance with international standards' without published rates = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. US rejection does NOT affect resolution. Fee schedule covering only IRGC-supervised vessels without general commercial applicability = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.
